notes: «مولى لعبد الله بن عمرو» describes Abu Qabus and is not a link; the last link is the Companion after «عن»
«يبلغ به النبي» is the report's own wording: the chain reaches the Prophet through the Companion, who ends it
The gloss «- المعنى -» is left out; Musaddad's omission of «مولى» is a wording remark
